description: Repairs r-ado-1b/param-decimal-scale: the Decimal column N had been made by DAO CreateField (Precision 38, Scale 0) and its stored values could not be decoded, so all 25 combinations returned an empty recordset. On a read-only ACE connection (own copy of r-fix-wire-ado-ado5, where K.N is DECIMAL(18,4) holding 3.125 in row a1, Null in a2, 0 in b3 and -0.0001 in b4, written as SQL literals), for each (Precision, NumericScale) of (default, default), (18, 3), (5, 2), (28, 10), (1, 0) and each value String "3.125", Double 3.125, Currency 3.125, String "3.1251", Long 3: a fresh Command on "SELECT ID FROM K WHERE N = ?" with a fresh appended Decimal input parameter; the parameter's metadata read before and after the Value put, the Value read back, Execute, all rows, Connection.Errors read and cleared right after. Asks how precision and scale change conversion and matching against the Decimal column.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-wire-ado probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
